an4.122:1.4: Imāni kho bhikkhave cattāri bhayāni udakorohantassa pāṭikaṅkhitabbāni. 2.
an4.122:1.5: Evam eva kho bhikkhave idh' ekacce kulaputte imasmiṃ dhammavinaye agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajite cattāri bhayāni pāṭikaṅkhitabbāni.
an4.122:2.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco kulaputto saddhā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito hoti--otiṇṇo
an4.122:2.3: 'mhi jātiyā jarāya maraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi dukkhotiṇṇo dukkhapareto,
an4.122:2.4: appeva nāma imassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa antakiriyā paññāyethāti.
an4.122:2.5: Tam enaṃ tathā pabbajitaṃ samānaṃ sabrahmacārī ovadanti anusāsanti--
an4.122:2.6: evan te abhikkamitabbaṃ evan te paṭikkamitabbaṃ evan te āloketabbaṃ evan te viloketabbaṃ evan te sammiñjitabbaṃ evan te pasāretabbaṃ evan te saṅghāṭipattacīvaraṃ dhāretabban ti.
an4.122:2.8: kho pubbe agāriyabhūtā samānā aññe ovadāma pi anusāsāma pi,
an4.122:2.9: ime pan' amhākam puttamattā maññe nattamattā maññe ovaditabbaṃ anusāsitabbaṃ maññantīti.
an4.122:2.10: So kupito anattamano sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvattati.
an4.122:2.11: Ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave bhikkhu ūmibhayassa bhīto sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvatto.
an4.122:2.12: Ūmibhayan ti kho bhikkhave kodhūpāyāsass' etaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
an4.122:3.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco kulaputto saddhā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito hoti--otiṇṇo
an4.122:3.5: Tam enaṃ tathā pabbajitaṃ samānaṃ sabrahmacārī ovadanti anusāsanti--idan
an4.122:3.6: te khāditabbaṃ idan te na khāditabbaṃ idan te bhuñjitabbaṃ idan te na bhuñjitabbaṃ idan te sāyitabbaṃ idan te na sāyitabbaṃ idan te pātabbaṃ idan te na pātabbaṃ, kappiyan te khāyitabbaṃ akappiyaṃ te na khāyitabbaṃ kappiyan te bhuñjitabbaṃ akappiyaṃ te na bhuñjitabbaṃ kappiyan te sāyitabbaṃ akappiyaṃ te na sāyitabbaṃ kappiyan te pātabbaṃ akappiyaṃ te na pātabbaṃ, kāle pātabbaṃ akāle na pātabbaṃ, kāle khāditabbaṃ vikāle na khāditabbaṃ kāle te bhuñjitabbaṃ vikāle na bhuñjitabbaṃ kāle te sāvitabbaṃ vikāle na sāyitabbaṃ kāle te pātabbaṃ vikāle na pātabban ti.
an4.122:3.8: kho pubbe agāriyabhūtā samānā yaṃ icchāma tam khādāma yaṃ na icchāma na taṃ khādāma
an4.122:3.9: yaṃ icchāma taṃ bhuñjāma yaṃ na icchāma na taṃ bhuñjāma
an4.122:3.10: yaṃ icchāma taṃ sāyāma yaṃ na icchāma na taṃ sāyāma
an4.122:3.11: yaṃ icchāma taṃ pipāma yaṃ na icchāma na taṃ pipāma,
an4.122:3.12: kappiyam pi khādāma akappiyam pi khādāma . . . kappiyam pi pipāma akappiyam pi pipāma, kāle pi khādāma vikāle pi khadāma . . . kāle pi pipāma vikāle pipāma.
an4.122:3.13: Yam pi no saddhā gahapatikā divā vikāle paṇītaṃ khādaniyaṃ vā bhojaniyam vā denti, tatra pi 'me mukhāvaraṇaṃ maññe karontīti,
an4.122:3.15: Ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave bhikkhu kumbhīlabhayassa bhīto sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvatto.
an4.122:3.16: Kumbhīlabhayan ti kho bhikkhave odarikattass' etaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
an4.122:4.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco kulaputto saddhā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito hoti:
an4.122:4.5: So evaṃ pabbajito samāno pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaram ādāya gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā piṇḍāya pavisati arakkhiten' eva kāyena arakkhitāya vācāya arakkhittena cittena anupaṭṭhitāya satiyā asaṃvutehi indriyehi.
an4.122:4.6: So tattha passati gahapatiṃ vā gahapatiputtaṃ vā pañcahi kāmaguṇehi samappitaṃ samaṅgibhūtaṃ paricārayamānaṃ.
an4.122:4.8: mayaṃ kho pubbe agāriyabhūtā samānā pañcahī kāmaguṇehi samappitā samaṅgibhūtā paricārimha,
an4.122:4.9: saṃvijjante kho pana me kule bhogā
an4.122:4.10: sakkā bhoge ca bhuñjituṃ puññāni ca kātuṃ,
an4.122:4.11: yan nūnāhaṃ sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvattitvā bhoge ca bhuñjeyyaṃ puññāni ca kareyyan ti.
an4.122:4.13: Ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave bhikkhu āvaṭṭabhayassa bhīto sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvatto.
an4.122:4.14: Āvaṭṭabhayan ti kho bhikkhave pañcann' etaṃ kāmaguṇānaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
an4.122:5.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco kulaputto saddhā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito hoti:
an4.122:5.5: So evaṃ pabbajito samāno pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaram ādāya gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā piṇḍāya pavisati arakkhiten' eva kāyena . . . arakkhitena cittena anupaṭṭhitāya satiyā asaṃvutehi indriyehi.
an4.122:5.6: So tattha passati mātugāmaṃ dunnivatthaṃ vā duppārutaṃ vā,
an4.122:5.7: tassa mātugāmaṃ disvā dunnivatthaṃ vā duppārutaṃ vā rāgo cittaṃ anuddhaṃseti,
an4.122:5.8: so rāgānuddhastena cittena sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvattati.
an4.122:5.9: Ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave bhikkhu susukābhayassa bhīto sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvatto.
an4.122:5.10: Susukābhayan ti kho bhikkhave mātugāmass' etaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
an4.122:5.12: Imāni kho bhikkhave cattāri bhayāni idh' ekacce kulaputte imasmiṃ dhammavinaye saddhā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajite pātikaṅkhitabbānīti. 123. 1.
